Greedy online is below fixed by 23.2 pp at 5% and 8.8 pp at 10%, and ties at 25% and 50%. That favors the fixed rule, so claim 2 is not supported and the confound is controlled. The baselines use only the same verified-label stream, so they have no information advantage. Greedy minus recal is -25.6, -2.6, +0.9 and -0.0 pp at 5, 10, 25 and 50%; versus plain fixed it is -23.2, -8.8, 0.0 and -0.1. Differences favor the fixed rule or span zero, so claim 2 is not_supported. L1b and L2b only raise the bar. For claim 3, only E01 reports embedding AUC gain and neighbor ratio; no non-E01 entry does, so it is neither killed nor supported and stays open. G01 compares the learned greedy allocator with recal and fixed agreement thresholds at equal budget. Those baselines use only the verified-label stream the learner also sees, so they have no free labels. Greedy minus recal is -25.6, -2.6, +0.9 and 0.0 pp at 5, 10, 25 and 50%, which favors the fixed rule or spans zero. That gives claim 2 not_supported, and the free-label confound is controlled, so W2 is false. For claim 3, only E01 reports embedding AUC (gain -0.001, neighbor ratio about 1.0). G01, L1b and L2b use the same model, task and proxy and report no embedding statistics, so there is no qualifying non-E01 kill and claim 3 stays open. The ledger does not call claim 3 supported, so W3 is false.
